\newcommand{\MparEightyDecisionLowestUsesPolicyN}{6}  % 80x25n30: rows of the table (combinations without and with setups at 60, 300, 600 s on the request clock; instances 3-11) whose lowest value uses the policy (its sampled schedules, or a search started from the policy's schedule)

\newcommand{\MparBothDecisionLowestPolSmpN}{3}  % 50x25n30 and 80x25n30 together: rows of the table (combinations without and with setups at 60, 300, 600 s on the request clock; instances 3-11) whose lowest printed value is in the column the policy, sampled schedules (a tie counts in each tied column)
\newcommand{\MparBothDecisionLowestMemRuleStartN}{0}  % 50x25n30 and 80x25n30 together: rows of the table (combinations without and with setups at 60, 300, 600 s on the request clock; instances 3-11) whose lowest printed value is in the column best of the eight memetic runs started from the rule schedule (a tie counts in each tied column)

\newcommand{\MparBothDecisionLowestCpPolStartN}{3}  % 50x25n30 and 80x25n30 together: rows of the table (combinations without and with setups at 60, 300, 600 s on the request clock; instances 3-11) whose lowest printed value is in the column CP-SAT started from the policy's schedule (a tie counts in each tied column)
\newcommand{\MparBothDecisionTieN}{0}  % 50x25n30 and 80x25n30 together: rows of the table (combinations without and with setups at 60, 300, 600 s on the request clock; instances 3-11) with two or more lowest columns
